title: Patients and history in noctune
tagline: The whole history, one tap away.

headline: Find the
patient.
scenes.narration: This video covers a patient's history. Patients lists everyone in your practice, and how many visits each one has had. Search by pet or owner name. Typing Jamie finds Mochi. Open a patient to see their profile.

headline: Every visit,
one page.
scenes.narration: The profile shows vitals trends from each visit, then Encounter History. Every visit shows its time, length, a short summary, and a status. Ready means a draft is waiting for your review. Completed means it's finished. Click a visit to open it.

headline: What did we
do last time?
scenes.narration: While you review today's note, open Past Encounters. Each earlier visit has a short summary, and Open shows it in a new tab. Expand a visit to read its full note beside today's. Here, the wellness exam shows her weight then, and the vaccines she was given.

headline: Jump to any
patient.
scenes.narration: From any page, press Command K and type a pet or owner name. Quick matches appear as you type. Choose the patient to land on their profile.

headline: Tidy the list,
keep the record.
scenes.narration: To tidy the list, remove a patient you no longer see. noctune archives the patient instead of deleting anything. They leave the patient list, and their transcripts and notes are not affected.

headline: History on
iPhone.
scenes.narration: On iPhone, search Patients by name and tap one to see every visit, newest first. Global search and archiving are on the web.
